title: Earth and Space Sciences

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Students in good academic standing may declare this major at any time.

sections.credentialOverview:
Credential Overview

The Bachelor of Arts in Earth and Space Sciences is designed for students who wish to obtain a broad understanding of earth sciences as a background for professional careers such as science journalism, environmental law, science education, and environmental policy.
sections.credentialRecommendedPrep:
Recommended Preparation

Suggested First- and Second-Year College Courses: Q SCI 291 and Q SCI 292, or MATH 124 and MATH 125, or MATH 134 and MATH 135; PHYS 114 and PHYS 117, or PHYS 121, or PHYS 141; CHEM 142, CHEM 143, or CHEM 145.
sections.credentialCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

82-90 credits

• Supporting Science (27-32 credits): 

• Basic Supporting Science (20-21 credits): 

• CHEM 142, CHEM 143, or CHEM 145

• one of the following options: (1) MATH 124, MATH 125; (2) MATH 134, MATH 135; (3) Q SCI 291, Q SCI 292

• one of the following options: (1) PHYS 114, PHYS 117; (2) PHYS 121; (3) PHYS 141

• Supporting Sciences and Math (3-6 credits): one from AMATH 352, CHEM 152, CHEM 153, CHEM 155, MATH 126, MATH 136, MATH 200, MATH 208, MATH 224, both PHYS 115 and PHYS 118, PHYS 122, or PHYS 142

• Statistics and Computing (4-5 credits): one course from AMATH 301, CSE 121, CSE 142, CSE 160, Q SCI 256, Q SCI 381, STAT 290, STAT 311

• ESS Courses (40-43 credits): 

• Required courses (15-18 credits): 

• Three courses from ESS 302, ESS 303, ESS 305, ESS 311, ESS 312, ESS 313, ESS 314, ESS 316, ESS 329

• ESS 298; one of ESS 398 or ESS 399

• ESS elective courses: minimum 25 credits of upper-division ESS prefixed courses with at least 10 credits at the 400-level (may not include independent study or seminar courses numbered ESS 489 through ESS 499.)

• Concentration (15 credits): 15 credits from one concentration area: business, education, geographic information systems, interdisciplinary science, law and policy, or science communication (see department for approved list). Courses counted toward this requirement cannot be used for any other major requirements. Courses not on the approved list may count toward this requirement if approved in advance by ESS Advising.

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA for all ESS-prefixed courses at the UW.
